insights: The Four of Cups suggests a lack of attention and missed opportunities, while the Hanged Man (reversed) indicates an impasse needing stillness. Strength (reversed) hints at hidden self-doubt. The Page of Wands encourages stepping into passions cautiously. Nine of Pentacles (reversed) points to past wounds that need healing. These cards suggest embracing a pause and letting go of control, focusing on renewal and new perspectives.
